versions.changelog:
Initial release of teslamate-deploy provides end-to-end TeslaMate installation for local or remote Debian-based systems:

- Guides users through selecting target (local or remote) and gathering necessary SSH details.
- Performs pre-flight checks, including OS validation, port availability, and SSH connectivity.
- Automates TeslaMate deployment using bundled shell scripts.
- Runs post-install health checks to ensure services are operational.
- Generates a user-facing usage document with access details after successful setup.
